name: Massage & Bodywork
headline: Care for how your body feels, moves, and recovers.
summary: Restore capacity: comfort, movement, recovery, body awareness and physical adaptability.
description: Personalized massage and bodywork that supports comfort, movement, recovery, body awareness and physical adaptability. From everyday tension and training recovery to prenatal massage, post-surgical support, manual lymphatic drainage and comfort-focused care during chronic illness, each session is adapted to your needs, circumstances and goals.
metaDescription: Personalized massage and bodywork in Livingston County Michigan: recovery, sports, prenatal and lymphatic care, adapted to how your body feels.
scopeNote: When medical circumstances are involved, services are provided within the appropriate scope of practice and may require medical clearance or coordination with your healthcare team.

value.heading: How we help
value.lead: Massage and bodywork at TAB are personalized around the individual—not just the appointment type.
paragraphs: We consider how you feel, move, recover, and function, along with your current health circumstances, goals, and stage of life.

Sessions may range from therapeutic bodywork and sports massage to prenatal massage, recovery-focused work, manual lymphatic drainage, and supportive massage for people managing chronic health conditions.

cards.title: Everyday tension and stress
cards.body: Ease the tension and strain that build up in daily life and work.

cards.title: Training recovery
cards.body: Support recovery from strength training, sport, and physically demanding work.

cards.title: Prenatal and postpartum
cards.body: Comfort-focused care adapted to pregnancy and the months after.

cards.title: Post-surgical support
cards.body: Gentle, appropriate care when you have medical clearance to begin.

cards.title: Manual lymphatic drainage
cards.body: Light, specialized technique to support healthy lymphatic movement.

cards.title: Chronic illness comfort
cards.body: Supportive care designed around changing health needs and energy.

value.transform: Address tension, restrictions and recovery needs.
value.adapt: Improve the body’s ability to respond and recover.
value.balance: Recalibrate effort, restoration and physical demand.
value.quote: Restore capacity so the body has more room to move, recover and respond.

steps.title: Before
steps.body: A short intake covers what brings you in, relevant health information, and your preferences for pressure and focus.

steps.title: During
steps.body: Your session is adapted to how you feel today. You can adjust pressure, positioning, or focus at any time.

steps.title: After
steps.body: We close with what changed, what to notice, and what might support you next.

items.q: Is this my first massage? What should I expect?
items.a: We’ll start with a brief conversation about what brings you in and any preferences. You stay in control of pressure and comfort throughout, and you can ask questions at any time.

items.q: Can I get a massage while pregnant?
items.a: Yes. Prenatal massage is adapted for comfort and safety at each stage of pregnancy. Let us know how far along you are when you book.
After recent surgery, during some treatments, or with certain health conditions, we may ask for clearance from your healthcare provider before your session.
It depends on your goals. We’ll suggest a rhythm that fits what you’re working on and your schedule—never more than you need.
